summary: Reviewed single-file change in mcp-server/src/gui/config.ts — three targeted edits: schema field addition, omit list update, writeConfig strip update.
Schema addition (line 26): orchestrator_logs_dir: z.string().optional() is correct — optional with no default, GuiConfig type infers string | undefined as required.
GuiConfigPartialSchema omit (line 37): correctly omits orchestrator_logs_dir alongside ledger_root from PUT partial updates; JSDoc updated to document both omitted fields — well-maintained contract.

writeConfig strip (line 142): destructure pattern correctly prevents callers from overwriting the field; consistent with the existing ledger_root guard. The _ignored/_ignored2 naming is a known low-priority readability concern (flagged by Developer and QA) — non-blocking.

DEFAULT_CONFIG (line 44-49): intentionally does not list orchestrator_logs_dir; correct because the field has no default value (.optional() alone) and undefined is the right zero value for a missing optional string.

No new test coverage added for the new field. The test suite (1547 tests) exercises the surrounding schema and writeConfig strip logic but contains no explicit assertions for orchestrator_logs_dir round-trip behaviour or strip verification. This is a coverage gap (low priority) not a blocker.
All 5 acceptance criteria are confirmed met; implementation and QA both PASS with zero TypeScript errors.

comments.note: config.ts line 142: _ignored/_ignored2 naming in writeConfig() destructure grows awkward as more server-only fields are added. A dedicated stripServerOnlyFields() helper (or a single Object.fromEntries filter keyed on a SERVER_ONLY_FIELDS constant) would be more maintainable and self-documenting. Non-blocking now; worth addressing before a third server-only field is added.

No dedicated test exercises orchestrator_logs_dir behaviour: (1) GuiConfigSchema.parse({ orchestrator_logs_dir: '/some/path' }) round-trip, (2) writeConfig strips orchestrator_logs_dir (analogous to the existing ledger_root strip test at line 137). Existing suite is passing, but future regressions on this field would not be caught automatically. Recommend adding two tests mirroring the ledger_root coverage.

JSDoc on writeConfig() (line 132-134) still only mentions ledger_root in its strip description. It was updated in the schema area but not in the function-level JSDoc. Minor inconsistency — worth a one-line update to mention orchestrator_logs_dir alongside ledger_root.
